main_text.l: Quædam deniq; in medio relinquit. Quæ ne-
cessariò dictat facienda natura, ea cùm fiunt, justa
sunt ubiq; & apud omnes; idq; naturâ, non opinione.
Hujus generis sunt omnium virtutum actiones pro-
pria, quæ è principiis naturæ per demonstrationẽ ex-

ea cùm fiunt, injusta sunt, ubiq; & apud omnes,
idq; naturâ, non opinione. Hujusmodi sunt omnes actio-

page.notes: The underlining under "Quæ" in three places (before "ne-", "necessariò" and "in medio") is printed emphasis, not text, and is not marked. The abbreviation after "ubiq" and "idq" is a printed sign resembling a 3 with a q; it is transcribed as "q;" and may be a different abbreviation. The first line opens without an indent, so the paragraph is taken as continuing from the previous page. Abbreviation mark after "neq" and "ideoq" read as a 3-shaped sign, transcribed as "3" [?]. The Greek at the top line is partly cut off; "ἐπαμφοτερίζοντα" is a best reading [?]. The Greek "ἁπλῶς" is read from the scan with its breathing and accent [?]. Only the catchword κατά is printed below the text.
